''See also: [[Path of Grasping Sky Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Path]] of Grasping Sky is the specialized power used by the imperial clan. It is characterized by the manifestation of large, emerald-green wings and allows practitioners to utilize [[wind]]-based techniques. Those who follow this [[Path]] can employ [[Ruler techniques]] to seize targets and [[Striker techniques]] to exert crushing force. Members of the [[Naru family]] utilize this [[Path]], though their wings may appear less complete than those of more established practitioners. Additionally, the [[Path]] is associated with the [[Skysworn]], a group of [[sacred artists]] who wear green armor and utilize emerald wings as a symbol of their status.}}
